description: Create, modify and extract from archives.

next.name: m
tip: Move files in the archive; a/b place them after/before a member.

next.name: p
tip: Print files found in the archive.

next.name: q
tip: Quickly append files to the archive.

next.name: r
tip: Replace existing files or insert new ones into the archive.

next.name: s
tip: Act as ranlib and write an archive index.

next.name: t
tip: Display the contents of the archive; O shows offsets, v is verbose.

next.name: x
tip: Extract files from the archive; o preserves original dates.

option.name: --output
tip: Specify the output directory for extraction.

option.name: --record-libdeps
tip: Specify the dependencies of this library.

option.name: -M
tip: Read an MRI script from standard input.
